traits.name: Brute.
traits.text: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn).
traits.text: The bugbear deals an extra 2d6 damage when it hits with a weapon attack roll that has advantage, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the bugbear that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Morningstar.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, plus 2d6 sneak attack damage.

actions.name: Javelin.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
